小朋友要听喜马音频，不想给手机，就得导出音频放mp3里。<br>
1，找到专辑起始音频的START_TRACK_ID <img id="aimg_SV1Mv" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://s41.ax1x.com/2026/05/02/pe79Vrd.md.png" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://s41.ax1x.com/2026/05/02/pe79Vrd.md.png"><br>
2，用python,批量找到音频的地址。方法如下<br>
2，复制到downie 4下载<br>
<div style="padding:15px 0;"><div style="font-size:12px;">[Asm] <em class="viewsource" style="cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;color:#369 !important;">纯文本查看</em> <em class="copycode" style="cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;color:#369 !important;">复制代码</em></div><pre class="brush: asm; gutter: true">import requests
import time
import json

HEADERS = {
    'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS 16_0 like Mac OS X) AppleWebKit/605.1.15 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/16.0 Mobile/15E148 Safari/604.1',
    'Accept': 'application/json, text/plain, */*',
    'Accept-Language': 'zh-CN,zh;q=0.9,en;q=0.8'
}

START_TRACK_ID = ''//这里要在浏览里打开起始音频的网址，我是用chrome的f12工具找的。
OUTPUT_FILE = 'audio_links_list.txt'

def get_relative_tracks(track_id):
    """获取相邻音频"""
    url = 'https://www.ximalaya.com/m-revision/page/track/queryRelativeTracksById'
    params = {
        'trackId': track_id,
        'preOffset': 0,
        'nextOffset': 10,
        'countKeys': 'play',
        'order': 2
    }
    
    try:
        response = requests.get(url, params=params, headers=HEADERS, timeout=15)
        if response.status_code == 200:
            return response.json()
        else:
            return None
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'请求异常: {e}')
        return None

def collect_all_urls():
    """收集所有URL"""
    all_urls = []
    current_track_id = START_TRACK_ID
    visited_ids = set()
    iteration = 1
    
    print(f'开始收集，起始trackId: {START_TRACK_ID}')
    print('=' * 70)
    
    while True:
        print(f'\n第 {iteration} 轮 - trackId: {current_track_id}')
        
        data = get_relative_tracks(current_track_id)
        
        if not data or data.get('ret') != 0:
            print(f'API返回异常，ret={data.get("ret") if data else "None"}')
            break
        
        # 获取data字段（可能是list或dict）
        data_content = data.get('data')
        
        if not data_content:
            print('没有data内容')
            break
        
        # 判断是list还是dict
        if isinstance(data_content, list):
            track_list = data_content
        else:
            track_list = data_content.get('nextTrackList', [])
        
        print(f'获取到 {len(track_list)} 个音频')
        
        if not track_list:
            print('没有更多音频了')
            break
        
        # 提取URL
        new_urls = []
        for track in track_list:
            track_id = str(track.get('id', ''))
            
            if track_id in visited_ids:
                continue
            
            # 从pageUriInfo中获取url
            page_uri = track.get('pageUriInfo', {})
            url_path = page_uri.get('url', '')
            
            if url_path:
                full_url = f'https://www.ximalaya.com{url_path}'
                new_urls.append(full_url)
                all_urls.append(full_url)
                visited_ids.add(track_id)
        
        if not new_urls:
            print('没有新URL了')
            break
        
        # 打印这一批
        for i, url in enumerate(new_urls, 1):
            print(f'  {i}. {url}')
        
        # 获取最后一个trackId
        last_track = track_list[-1]
        current_track_id = str(last_track.get('id', ''))
        
        iteration += 1
        time.sleep(0.5)
    
    return all_urls

def save_results(urls):
    """保存结果"""
    if not urls:
        print('没有结果可保存')
        return
    
    with open(OUTPUT_FILE, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        for url in urls:
            f.write(f'{url}\n')
    
    print(f'\n已保存 {len(urls)} 个URL到 {OUTPUT_FILE}')
    
    print('\n' + '=' * 70)
    print('前10个:')
    for i, url in enumerate(urls[:10], 1):
        print(f'{i}. {url}')
    
    if len(urls) &gt; 20:
        print('\n...\n')
        print('最后10个:')
        for i, url in enumerate(urls[-10:], len(urls)-9):
            print(f'{i}. {url}')

def main():
    print('喜马拉雅音频链接收集器')
    print('=' * 70)
    
    urls = collect_all_urls()
    
    if not urls:
        print('未收集到URL！')
        return
    
    print(f'\n收集完成！共 {len(urls)} 个URL')
    save_results(urls)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()</pre></div></td></tr></tbody></table>
